canonical_name: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
notes: Aerial photo clearly shows EPFL's Rolex Learning Center (distinctive dome/crater roof structure) and surrounding Lausanne campus buildings. Correctly identified, unmistakable campus imagery.
Photo shows the Hall of Languages, Syracuse University's iconic and instantly recognizable landmark building on the quad. Correct institution.

Aerial photo of a modern stepped/terraced glass-and-concrete building complex with a pyramidal skylight, in a Swiss town ringed by mountains — consistent with HSG's well-known modern campus architecture and St. Gallen's alpine geography.

Original stored image was a marketing composite: the building facade was almost entirely obscured by a large Estonian-language promotional slogan overlay ('TARGA ELUVIISI EEST VEDAJA!') plus the university logo — not a clean campus photo. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons daytime photo of the entrance to Tallinn University's Mare building (Uus-Sadama 5), CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL, author Alma Pater; file description explicitly identifies it as Tallinn University's Mare building entrance.

Student-life photo: two students wearing University of Cincinnati-branded apparel, with a laptop covered in UC/Cincy stickers, seated in the university's stadium bleachers. Correctly identifies this institution and qualifies as a legitimate student-life photograph.
Photo shows the Ross Building/Vari Hall area with the reflecting pool at York University's Keele campus in Toronto, Canadian flag visible. Correct institution.

Original stored image was just the Nagoya University logo/wordmark (green stylized crest + 'NAGOYA UNIVERSITY' text) on a plain white background, no campus content. Replaced with a public-domain Wikimedia Commons photo of Nagoya University's Tsurumai Campus buildings (Showa-ku, Nagoya), file description explicitly identifies the location/institution.
Photo shows a campus tower building with visible 'FIU' lettering, framed by royal palm trees, students walking on the plaza. Correct institution.

Original stored image was a logo lockup graphic ('T A&M' block logo + 'TEXAS A&M UNIVERSITY' wordmark) over a heavily faded/greyed-out aerial backdrop — effectively a logo, not a usable campus photo. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the iconic domed Academic Building at Texas A&M, CC BY 2.0, author Donnie Ray Jones, file description confirms Texas A&M University campus.

Original stored image was a real campus building at sunset but overlaid with a designed marketing graphic treatment: a blue grid pattern spanning a quarter of the frame plus a circular 'FAR ABOVE' stamp/seal graphic (KU's fight-song tagline) in the corner — a marketing composite, not a clean photo. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the KU Memorial Campanile, a well-known campus landmark, CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL.

Student-life photo: two students studying with a laptop on a rooftop terrace, with the distinctive terraced-vineyard, snow-capped-mountain landscape of Bolzano/South Tyrol clearly visible behind them, matching unibz's real campus setting. Correct institution.
Photo shows the ornate main building of Warsaw University of Technology (Politechnika Warszawska), with 'POLITECHNIKA' visible on the facade frieze. Correct institution.

Original stored image was a pure text/wordmark graphic ('IT'sMOre than a UNIVERSITY' slogan), no campus photo content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo (Oct 2024) of ITMO University's main building in Saint Petersburg; facade clearly reads 'УНИВЕРСИТЕТ ИТМО' (ITMO University), unambiguous identification. CC BY-SA 4.0. Note: direct curl to upload.wikimedia.org hit a 429 rate limit from shared fleet egress; used WebFetch (which saves the binary locally) plus Read on the saved file to view it instead.

Photo shows the Geisel Library at UC San Diego, an unmistakable, iconic building silhouette, shot at sunset with a heavy stylized color-grade filter. Still a genuine photo of the correct, identifiable building (not an illustration).

Original stored image was just the Université de Namur logo/wordmark (green/grey book-shaped 'UN' icon + text) on a plain white background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo explicitly captioned 'Université de Namur - ancienne entrée principale à la rue de Bruxelles' (former main entrance building on rue de Bruxelles), CC BY-SA 4.0. Note: curl to upload.wikimedia.org 429'd again; used WebFetch-saved-binary + Read fallback.

Original stored image was the VCU seal + 'VCU' wordmark logo on a black background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the James Branch Cabell Library, VCU's main library on the Monroe Park Campus; entrance signage visibly reads 'VCU' and 'JAMES BRANCH CABELL LIBRARY'. CC BY 3.0/GFDL. Curl 429'd; used WebFetch-saved-binary + Read fallback.

Original stored image was the Kyung Hee University crest/seal (two robed figures with laurel wreath, Latin-style emblem) on a plain white background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Grand Auditorium, Kyung Hee's iconic Gothic-style landmark building on the Seoul campus. CC BY 3.0.

Original stored image was the University of Bradford crest/logo (four-quadrant emblem: globe, shuttle, book icons on dark green) with no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Chesham Building and Peace Garden at University of Bradford, CC BY 2.0, author Tim Green; file description explicitly identifies the building and institution.

Original stored image showed a group of students walking down a generic UK high street (Boots pharmacy and other nationwide chain storefronts visible), with no identifiable campus building, signage, or Loughborough-specific landmark — a generic lifestyle photo, not identifiable campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of Hazlerigg Hall, a recognizable Loughborough University residence building with its landscaped front lawn. CC BY 2.0.
Student-life photo: students relaxing/socializing on a campus lawn beside a pond, with recognizable modern campus buildings in the background. Genuine identifiable campus content.

Photo shows a modern campus interior atrium/study lounge with students working at tables, distinctive artistic tree-shaped light fixtures. Genuine student-life/campus interior photo, consistent with University of Copenhagen's modern campus buildings.

Photo shows real graduating students in academic regalia; zoomed inspection confirms the diploma folders they hold are printed 'UNIVERSITI PENDIDIKAN SULTAN IDRIS', confirming correct institution. A small 'UNDERGRADUATE' caption sits in the bottom-left corner but does not obscure the photographic content (unlike a true marketing composite), so this is treated as a genuine student-life/graduation photo.

canonical_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
notes: Student-life photo: three students socializing/studying with a laptop on tiered wood bench seating inside a modern academic building common space. Genuine, identifiable campus interior content.

Student-life photo: a student wearing an 'OREGON'-branded sweatshirt posing with the University of Oregon Duck mascot, campus building visible in background. Correct institution, clearly identifiable.

Original stored image was a purely textual strategic-plan announcement slide ('Bold & United — ESCP 2026-2030 Strategic Plan') on an abstract blue graphic background, no campus photo content at all. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons street-view photo of the ESCP Business School Paris campus building (79 Avenue de la République), CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL.

Original stored image was just the Tecnológico de Monterrey logo/wordmark (white flame icon) on solid blue background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo (Oct 2025) of the Rectoría building's iconic mural relief and the pyramidal CETEC building at the flagship Campus Monterrey, CC BY-SA 4.0 — chose this campus specifically over Tec's many satellite campuses (Santa Fe, CCM, Guadalajara, etc.) since this university record is the original Monterrey institution.

Original stored image was a generic tilt-shift aerial photo of Amsterdam canal-house rooftops with no identifiable UvA building, signage, or landmark — indistinguishable from any general Amsterdam tourist photo. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Maagdenhuis at Spui 21, University of Amsterdam's well-documented main administrative building (site of the famous 1969 student occupation). CC BY-SA 3.0 NL.
Aerial photo of the campus mall with reflecting pools and tree-lined walkway, clear 'UTD' lettering visible on a building. Correct institution.

Photo shows students actively engaged in a lecture hall (one raising a hand/speaking). Genuine lecture-hall content, an explicitly allowed PASS category; sourced from USC's own official site og:image.

Original stored image was a marketing composite: a bold red banner with the headline 'CAN COLLABORATION CHANGE THE WORLD?' and three small inset thumbnail photos, dominated by text/design rather than a clean campus photo. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of Brookings Hall, WashU's iconic Collegiate Gothic landmark on the Danforth Campus. CC BY (attribution-only).

Photo shows a grand staircase leading up to a distinctive brick campus building complex, partial Chinese-character signage visible on the facade. Matches PolyU's known campus architecture. Correct institution.

Aerial photo of campus amphitheater and reflecting pool with fountains, campus buildings and a lake visible in the background. Matches Clemson's distinctive campus layout near Lake Hartwell. Correct institution.

Student-life photo at an outdoor campus event; zoomed inspection confirms the hoodie sleeve reads 'MASSEY UNIVERSITY' with the university crest and Māori name 'Te Kunenga ki Pūrehuroa'. Correct institution, clearly confirmed.

Photo shows a campus building entrance with clear 'ITAM' lettering carved into the stone facade. Correct institution. A thin decorative green bar at the very bottom of the frame is a minor design element that does not obscure the photo.

Original stored image was just the IE University logo/wordmark (blue 'ie' + dot) on a plain white background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the IE Business School building at Calle de María de Molina, Madrid — IE Business School is IE University's founding school and this is its well-documented Madrid campus building. CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL. (Rejected an alternate candidate 'IE Universidad.jpg' which turned out to depict anti-university protest stickers in Segovia, not a usable campus photo.)

Photo shows the Rectorate Building of Universitas Hasanuddin, with its distinctive triangular red-and-white monument in front and the Indonesian flag flying. Recognizable campus landmark. Correct institution.
Aerial photo of a grand Baroque/classical-style main building complex in a small Austrian town setting, consistent with Montanuniversität Leoben's known main building. Correct institution.
Photo shows Universität Hamburg's main building with its distinctive columned rotunda entrance, a recognizable campus landmark. Correct institution.

Original stored image was just the 'tu dortmund' wordmark/logo on a plain white background, no campus content. Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Mathetower on TU Dortmund's North Campus (Campus Nord), the tower topped with the university's own 'tu' logo, cherry blossoms and students in the foreground confirming the campus setting. CC BY-SA 3.0. Curl 429'd; used WebFetch-saved-binary + Read fallback.

Original stored image was a highly stylized artistic/conceptual brand photo: a woman standing on a rock in a lake beneath a huge flowing green fabric banner across the sky, with no campus content whatsoever (an art/marketing composite in LUT's brand green). Replaced with a Wikimedia Commons photo (Jan 2020) of the LUT University Lappeenranta campus building, with 'LUT University' signage clearly visible on the brick facade and students entering. CC BY 4.0. Curl 429'd; used WebFetch-saved-binary + Read fallback (note: WebFetch's own text description of the binary was inaccurate/hallucinated - relied on the actual image view instead).

Student-life photo: a group of students sitting together in modern outdoor lounge chairs on a campus courtyard/patio, modern building visible behind with more students at tables. Genuine identifiable campus content.
Photo shows Rice University's Owl mascot wearing a 'RICE 12' jersey, with campus trees and a stone building visible in the background. Clearly branded, correct institution.
